IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark
brown hair stands with one hand in her
pocket against a gray studio backdrop.
She wears a dark brown fitted crop top,
layered silver chains, and a wide
studded belt with a pendant. Dark cargo
trousers with drawstring pockets and
silver bangles complete the look. Her
expression is confident, with a slight
smirk. Soft, even studio light. Palette of
chocolate, charcoal gray, and silver.
Playful and edgy, in the style of a Y2K
streetwear lookbook.
